en: A black‑and‑white photograph showing a group of men and women in traditional European folk costumes dancing in a circle on an outdoor wooden platform. The men wear knee-breeches, vests, long socks and boots; the women wear long dark skirts, aprons, blouses, and distinctive peaked or white caps. In the background, a large audience sits or stands among trees, and a flag on a tall pole is visible. The scene looks like a folk dance performance or festival.
